messages:
anika singh: Huge win — ZenWave Systems signed a co-sell agreement with us for a private deployment pilot at one of their regulated healthcare customers. :tada:

anika singh: This is a PRIVATE (VPC) pilot — they'll be testing our Dedicated runtime + on-prem connectors for secure data ingress.

mike chen: Amazing news! Huge props to the AE + solutions team. Who's owning the kickoff?

anika singh: @mike chen and @lina ortega will run the kickoff. Kickoff scheduled Wed 10am PT (invite sent). Lina will lead the infra checklist.

lina ortega: On it — I'll post the pre-kickoff checklist in the thread tomorrow. Need contacts from ZenWave and a list of required network ports.

josh rivera: SE notes — ZenWave requested sample latency/throughput numbers for 2 k8s+GPU nodes and a KV cache profile. I'll prepare a short perf doc and a perf run plan.

raj patel: Legal/compliance signoff done on our side (standard BAA + data residency addendum). I pushed the countersigned docs to the deal folder: https://redwood.internal/zenwave/deal.

vanessa (marketing): Love this. Can we capture a short case study / quote after pilot? I can put together a one-pager and a customer Q&A.

anika singh: Yes — ask for permission during pilot. We'll coordinate with Vanessa after week 2.

mike chen: Question for product: will this pilot include any feature flags (e.g., KV cache persistence, quantization profile) we should toggle? @josh rivera might have suggestions.

josh rivera: Recommend starting with KV cache enabled + int8 quantization profile B (safe quality). We can tweak after perf runs. I'll add config snippets to the kickoff doc.

lina ortega: Ops note: we need a temporary service account with IAM role 'private-deploy-admin' for ZenWave's infra team. @raj patel can you loop in security?

raj patel: Looping in security now. Also flagged a review for the HSM integration notes.

vanessa (marketing): I'll draft a short social post + internal case study template. Can someone drop a 1–2 sentence customer blurb we can share?

anika singh: Draft blurb: "ZenWave Systems selected Redwood Inference to power compliant, low-latency LLM features for their healthcare customer — pilot will validate private deployment and performance at scale." Feel free to shorten.

mike chen: Love it. Tiny ask: can growth provide an intro to our Marketplace team in case we spin this into an ISV listing later?

anika singh: Good idea. @vanessa (marketing) can you own the intro to marketplace folks post-pilot?

vanessa (marketing): Yep — will set up an intro if pilot goes well.

deploy-bot: [integration] 1882348000 — kickoff-invite.ics posted to thread.

lina ortega: Action items: 1) SE perf doc (josh) 2) Infra checklist (lina) 3) Legal docs in folder (raj) 4) Marketing one-pager (vanessa) 5) Kickoff Wed 10am PT.

anika singh: Thanks team — big win for partnerships & private deployments. Please update the deal tracker and tag me for blockers. :rocket:
